4 اتلد , (T, S, L.) and اتلد مَالًا, (T, M, Msb, K,) He got, obtained, or acquired, (اِتَّخَذَ,) property [such as is termed تِلَاد, as is implied in the T and M and K]: (T, S, L, Msb:) or he possessed
property such as is termed تِلَاد. (So accord. to the explanation of the act. part. n., q. v., in the Mgh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
